# The Patient Sky

> Personal year-ahead astrological forecasts by Bala Danmeri (Wincanton, Somerset, UK), prepared by hand using the method of Jean-Baptiste Morin (1583–1656). Currently offered free in return for an honest testimonial. Each forecast is a written PDF of around twenty pages, ready in about five days.

The method: nothing is forecast unless the birth chart promises it; primary directions give the year, the solar return the month, lunar returns a few days, transits the day. A date is named only where at least three of the four agree. Forecasts give windows, not guarantees, and are not medical, legal or financial advice.
